title: The Slow Fix: Why Quick Fixes Don’t Work (extract)
author: Carl Honoré
description: This is a free extract taken from the full version of THE SLOW FIX by Carl Honoré. What do we do when things go wrong in a fast world? Many of us go for the quick fix that delays the problem rather than solving it. To make real progress we need real solutions – we need to take time for THE SLOW FIX.
